finding_title: Unchecked type assertions in DrawMeasured can panic the render path
scope: Read-only finding-specific source inspection; no tests, edits, builds, native processes, Git or provider calls. Prism discarded the finding for path mapping; this independent disposition is based on actual source contracts, not discard reason.

evidence.fact: Ordinary paintSource.Draw already asserts c.(*composer.ComposerDrawer) and ps.renderer.(*rasterx.Renderer) before rendering. Its current SHA matches the frozen pre-stage36 render_notjs.go baseline.
DrawMeasured performs exactly the same composer and renderer assertions at the same pre-render boundary; it does not introduce a new accepted input type or a diagnostics-only renderer requirement.
The detailed method receiver is *ComposerDrawer and passes cd directly to measured.DrawMeasured(cd), so framework dispatch supplies the required composer type.
Ordinary scrimSource.Draw and fillInsetsSource.Draw likewise assert *ComposerDrawer, matching their detailed counterparts.
Both paths use the same paintSource instances and captured Scene/sprite renderer; diagnostics does not replace the renderer.

disposition: No demonstrated regression. A custom non-rasterx renderer passed to this native paint source already panics in ordinary Draw; the composer assertion is satisfied by the actual detailed ComposerDrawer dispatch. The suggested fallback to ps.Draw(c) would repeat the same assertions and cannot make unsupported renderer/composer inputs safe. Extending the native paint-source renderer contract is separate work, not warranted by this finding.
limits: This adjudication does not promise arbitrary custom renderer/composer compatibility or suppress existing panic semantics.
No independent runtime test is claimed.
